behavior.execution_release: This C science ruling does not authorize execution. A production runner/config must bind this exact lock SHA, implement the distinct metrics and joint gate, pass affected regressions and real GitHub archive fresh-fetch/restore testing, and receive a separate C execution authorization.
behavior.q6_metric_separation: Legacy global Q6 regression and <0.20 joint screen apply only to coherent/global Q6. V2 local Q6 is report-only pending independent calibration. The old and new Q6 values are not numerically compared.
behavior.strategy_change: This V2 spec supersedes only the qualitative RDF shape gate in the 20261012 strategy; it does not alter density, seed, potential, integrator, temperature schedule, step caps, or existing checkpoint. The adaptive run plan and runner must bind this exact spec SHA before C can sign execution.

d_audit_status.production_runner: NOT_RELEASED; latest D package explicitly excludes an execution-ready runner
d_audit_status.qa_v2_metrics_and_synthetic_suite: engineering evidence only; Q6 distinction adjudicated by this lock

finite_cell.rdf_rmax_rule: strictly less than half the shortest cell length; fail if cell or PBC differs from the locked source

msd.definition: unwrapped coordinates; multiple time origins; compute the 3D self MSD averaged over all 64 Ag atoms
msd.pass: delta MSD >= 1.0 A^2 and moving-block-bootstrap 95% lower confidence bound on the long-time slope > 0
msd.window: same combined 4 ps used by the structural gate

order.joint_liquid_decision: A phase may pass only if the legacy global-Q6 screen, PTM/cluster limits, resolved finite-cell RDF and coordination criteria, MSD diffusion criterion, and two-window thermal stationarity criteria all pass. Any missing, non-finite, unresolved, statistically underpowered, or inconsistent required input yields PENDING/HOLD. No single Q6 statistic proves liquid behavior.

legacy_global_q6.definition: For each atom i, compute q_6m(i) as the neighbor-average of Y_6m over periodic neighbors within 3.8 A; average q_6m(i) over all atoms first; then compute sqrt(4*pi/13 * sum_m |mean_i(q_6m(i))|^2). This is the coherent/global Steinhardt Q6 used by the archived legacy implementation.

historical_regression.meaning: This regression verifies the legacy global-Q6 implementation only. It does not constrain or compare against local Q6.

joint_liquid_gate.role: necessary_joint_screen_for_coherent_crystalline_order; insufficient on its own to establish a liquid

other_crystalline_order_gates.classifier: OVITO PTM, FCC/HCP only; RMSD cutoff 0.10; periodicity verified; no CNA fallback
other_crystalline_order_gates.persistent_order_gate: HOLD if the one-sided 95% moving-block-bootstrap lower confidence bound on the stationary-phase PTM crystalline-fraction slope is greater than zero

order.q6_relationship: The global and local statistics are mathematically distinct reductions of q_6m and are not expected to have equal values. Never apply the legacy 0.20 cutoff to mean-local Q6.

v2_local_q6.definition: for each atom i, neighbors are all atoms within 3.8 A under minimum-image PBC; q_6m(i)=mean_j Y_6m(r_ij), q6(i)=sqrt(4*pi/13 * sum_m |q_6m(i)|^2); frame_Q6 is the arithmetic mean of q6(i) over 64 atoms
v2_local_q6.liquid_gate_role: REPORT_ONLY; no threshold, no pass/fail, and no requirement to equal global Q6
v2_local_q6.trend_role: report time series and uncertainty as diagnostic; do not fail liquid solely on a local-Q6 trend until separately calibrated and versioned

bootstrap.insufficient_data_behavior: If fewer than 8 complete autocorrelation-sized blocks are available, keep the phase gate pending and automatically collect the next internal chunk; if the phase cap is reached first, report RDF_UNCERTAINTY_INSUFFICIENT and QA_HOLD.
bootstrap.integrated_autocorrelation_time: estimate for temperature, potential energy/atom, mean local q6, PTM crystal fraction, coordination number, and g(r) at the first-peak bin; use the maximum tau_int, with tau_int=dt*(0.5+sum rho(k)) through the first non-positive lag
bootstrap.method: resample contiguous trajectory blocks with replacement; never resample individual correlated frames
bootstrap.scope: Use all eligible stationary frames in the current fixed-temperature phase after the 2 ps discard; do not restrict the uncertainty estimate to only the final two windows. The separate final two windows still must each meet the point-estimate bounds.

coordination_number.definition: CN=4*pi*(N-1)/V * integral_0^rvalley g(r)*r^2 dr using trapezoidal integration of raw bins
coordination_number.uncertainty_rule: report a two-sided 95% moving-block-bootstrap interval; it must overlap the accepted range, and the point estimate must be within range

rdf.distance_method: minimum-image pair distances under full 3D PBC; count ordered pairs i != j
rdf.frame_windows: For each fixed-temperature phase, use all saved frames after its initial 2 ps discard and before the phase cap (up to 7.5 ps at 1600 K, up to 8 ps at 1250 K); frames are sampled every 0.05 ps. Also report the final two adjacent half-open 2 ps windows separately; each must meet the accepted peak/valley/CN point bounds.

histogram.normalization: g_b = H_b / (F * N * (N-1) * shell_volume_b / cell_volume); H_b is the count of ordered pairs across F frames and shell_volume_b=4*pi/3*(r_hi^3-r_lo^3)
histogram.smoothing_for_extrema_only: Gaussian filter sigma=0.10 A (2 bins); raw unsmoothed g(r) is used for coordination integration

peak_valley.peak_definition: highest local maximum of smoothed g(r) in the peak range
peak_valley.resolution_rule: the moving-block-bootstrap 95% lower confidence bound for g(r_peak)-g(r_valley) must be greater than zero; peak and valley must be detected in at least 95% of valid bootstrap replicates
peak_valley.unresolved_behavior: RDF_UNRESOLVED => QA_HOLD; never substitute a point estimate or default PASS
peak_valley.valley_definition: lowest local minimum of smoothed g(r) in the valley range after the selected peak

rdf.removed_qualitative_gate: Do not use uncalibrated 'broad peak' or 'no sharp higher-shell peaks' as a binary gate for this 64-atom cell. Those features remain diagnostics; sustained order is decided by the explicit Q6/PTM and MSD gates below.
report_only: first-peak FWHM from the smoothed curve
g(r) peak locations/heights for r>r_valley and r<rmax
per-window and pooled raw/smoothed g(r) arrays with bootstrap bands
rdf.rmax_note: For the locked rho100 cubic cell, rmax=5.35 A is below L/2=5.3587276576 A. If cell changes, fail identity check; do not silently recompute bins.
rdf.role: first-shell quantitative consistency gate; peak width and higher shells are diagnostic only

supersedes.scope: Q6 definitions, historical regression handling, and Q6 contribution to the joint liquid gate only. All non-Q6 V2 scientific criteria remain unchanged.
